title: (RHEA-2016:2014) Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.2.0 Release - Docker Images
portal_summary: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.2.0 Release - Docker Images
portal_synopsis: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform 4.2.0 Release - Docker Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Mobile Application Platform|Red Hat Mobile Application Platform|4.2|x86_64
portal_solution:
The Docker images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat
Container Registry at registry.access.redhat.com using the docker pull command.
Dockerfiles and scripts should be amended either to refer to these new images specifically, or to the latest images generally.
portal_description:
Red Hat Mobile Application Platform (RHMAP) 4.2 consists of three main components:

* Core - development and management of apps occurs in the RHMAP Core, which can be installed either in an on-premise installation of OpenShift Enterprise 3, or hosted and managed by Red Hat.
* MBaaS - Application data, runtime, and integrations are deployed to the RHMAP MBaaS installed in an on-premise installation of OpenShift Enterprise 3.
* Build Farm - deployed separately from the Core and the MBaaS, the Build Farm is shared between all instances of RHMAP. Third-party Linux, Windows, and Apple server hosting providers are used to support building client app binaries for all platforms.

The Core and MBaaS in RHMAP 4.2 are built on top of OpenShift Enterprise 3, Kubernetes, Docker, and Red Hat Software Collections. The Core and MBaaS both consist of several components, each running in its own container.
Similarly, every cloud app deployed to the MBaaS runs in a container.
Those containers are deployed and orchestrated by Kubernetes.

For this RHMAP release, the Docker-formatted container images required to run the Core and MBaaS inside OpenShift Enterprise 3.x are:

rhmap42/fh-aaa:1.0.2-2
rhmap42/fh-appstore:2.0.1-3
rhmap42/fh-mbaas:5.2.3-4
rhmap42/fh-messaging:3.0.1-3
rhmap42/fh-metrics:3.0.1-4
rhmap42/fh-ngui:5.4.22-1
rhmap42/fh-scm:1.0.5-3
rhmap42/fh-statsd:2.0.2-1
rhmap42/fh-supercore:4.5.5-1
rhmap42/fh-sdks:1.0.0-6
rhmap42/gitlab-shell:2.1.1-4
rhmap42/httpd:2.4-12
rhmap42/memcached:1.4.15-8
rhmap42/millicore:7.34.16-1
rhmap42/mongodb:3.2-9
rhmap42/mysql:5.5-6
rhmap42/nagios:4.0.8-25
rhmap42/redis:2.8.21-19
rhmap42/ups-eap:1.1.4-7
